primary_annotator: Codex conversation assistant, exact backend revision not exposed
input: blind_id plus text only; no author, source, article title, account category or narrative classifier prediction
definitions: Project annotation guide: seven classes plus Unclear; neutral factual reporting and unendorsed quotations are not automatically political narratives. Confidence 1 uncertain, 2 plausible, 3 clear.
main_label_selection: Primary assistant label Right-wing or Left-wing and confidence >=2, exact evidence span. Other classes and unclear remain saved for human review, not silently recoded.
independent_assessor: Separately run DeBERTa NLI, diagnostic agreement only.
